title: Happy giraffe
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- neck -->
  <rect x='42' y='40' width='16' height='38' rx='6' fill='#F5C542'/>
  <!-- neck spots -->
  <circle cx='46' cy='48' r='3' fill='#B5651D'/>
  <circle cx='53' cy='55' r='3.5' fill='#B5651D'/>
  <circle cx='46' cy='63' r='3' fill='#B5651D'/>
  <circle cx='53' cy='70' r='3.5' fill='#B5651D'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='80' rx='26' ry='16' fill='#F5C542'/>
  <!-- body spots -->
  <circle cx='36' cy='78' r='4' fill='#B5651D'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='84' r='4.5' fill='#B5651D'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='77' r='4' fill='#B5651D'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='30' y='88' width='7' height='11' rx='3' fill='#E0A800'/>
  <rect x='44' y='90' width='7' height='9' rx='3' fill='#E0A800'/>
  <rect x='58' y='90' width='7' height='9' rx='3' fill='#E0A800'/>
  <rect x='70' y='88' width='7' height='11' rx='3' fill='#E0A800'/>
  <!-- hooves -->
  <rect x='30' y='96' width='7' height='4' rx='2' fill='#8B5E3C'/>
  <rect x='44' y='96' width='7' height='4' rx='2' fill='#8B5E3C'/>
  <rect x='58' y='96' width='7' height='4' rx='2' fill='#8B5E3C'/>
  <rect x='70' y='96' width='7' height='4' rx='2' fill='#8B5E3C'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='28' rx='15' ry='12' fill='#F5C542'/>
  <!-- ossicones -->
  <rect x='42' y='14' width='3' height='9' rx='1.5' fill='#E0A800'/>
  <circle cx='43.5' cy='13' r='3' fill='#B5651D'/>
  <rect x='55' y='14' width='3' height='9' rx='1.5' fill='#E0A800'/>
  <circle cx='56.5' cy='13' r='3' fill='#B5651D'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='24' rx='6' ry='3.5' fill='#E0A800' transform='rotate(-20 36 24)'/>
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='24' rx='6' ry='3.5' fill='#E0A800' transform='rotate(20 64 24)'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='34' rx='9' ry='6' fill='#FFE27A'/>
  <!-- nostrils -->
  <circle cx='47' cy='33' r='1.2' fill='#C49A00'/>
  <circle cx='53' cy='33' r='1.2' fill='#C49A00'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M45 36 Q50 40 55 36' stroke='#C49A00' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='26' r='2.5' fill='#3B2A1A'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='25.3' r='0.9' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='26' r='2.5' fill='#3B2A1A'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='25.3' r='0.9' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- blush -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='31' r='2.5' fill='#FF9B9B' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='31' r='2.5' fill='#FF9B9B' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M76 78 Q84 72 82 66' stroke='#E0A800' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='82' cy='64' r='3' fill='#B5651D'/>
</svg>
